summary: Agents and missions can preview a rename (rename-id --plan) and verify it afterwards (rename-proof) through new read-only API and CLI routes.

replay.detail: Existing naming claims and projections require no replay.

schema.detail: No storage migration, new claim kind or client-v0 schema change.

rules.detail: Read-only rename admission and selected-chain evidence reuse existing naming rules.

compatibility.detail: Existing rename and portable proof commands remain compatible; owned-set previews now resolve canonical names before membership comparison.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal binary restart.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback requires no data migration.
